name: license-notice
body: License & notices: repo-root `LICENSE` (Apache-2.0 full text, covering the repo except `brand/`); repo-root `NOTICE` naming reveal.js vendored under MIT at `internal/assets/reveal/LICENSE` (part of embedded-assets), stating the `brand/` exclusion, and stating that "kalide" and the logo are Really Knows AI trademarks not licensed under Apache-2.0 (§6); and repo-root `TRADEMARKS.md` (short permitted-use policy). Also drives the `license` field in `Formula/kalide.rb` to `"Apache-2.0"` (owned by homebrew-formula).
